maya: quick heads-up, when I loaded the merged Llama3 -> MistralX weights i see headwise rope wrapping artifacts on long-context runs.
maya: reproducer: ran local eval harness on 32k context samples.
maya: Symptoms: repeated token chunks, attention spikes per-head, and a soft collapse after ~6k tokens.
maya: example output (truncated): "... the cat the cat the cat ..." and runtime log: `nan in attn_scores head 7`
jun: hmm. can you paste the model config you used?
maya: sure:
```
{"model_type": "llama3", "rotary_pct": 0.25, "rotary_base": 10000, "num_heads": 32}
```
maya: command:
```
./eval_harness --model /mnt/checkpoints/llama3-mistral-merged --context 8192 --seed 42 --batch 1
```
olivia: two quick suspects: tokenizer/vocab id mapping + per-head rotary phase scaling mismatch when merging head-wise params.
olivia: check the tokenizer's `added_tokens` and ensure vocab.json hasn't shifted ids.
olivia: also verify `rotary_base` and whether merging script applied headwise scaling vs scalar.
sahil: i ran a short float32 vs q4 test, quant looks worse (more repeats). can you try running `--no-quant` and `--headwise-debug` flags?
sahil: also try this snippet to dump first kv cache key ids:
```
# dump first 4 kv ids
python tools/dump_kv.py --model /mnt/checkpoints/llama3-mistral-merged --n 4
```

ops-bot: :rotating_light: ingest: model-compat-check pipeline queued
jun: maya, can you run a minimal single-sequence deterministic run (seed 0, temp 0) and attach logits diffs vs reference weights?
maya: will do, starting now. ping me in ~30m
jun: good. if vocab is same, i'd look at head permutation/transpose during fusion step. seen it before when merging parallel-attention kernels.
olivia: FYI, also add a quick test: create tiny model with 2 heads and compare raw rotary phase matrices elementwise between src and merged.
maya: preliminary: single-seq run shows head 7 phase offset of ~1.57 rad vs ref. attaching dump in thread when ready.
